pairs.name: LROC NAC sun 005 vs 055 (d-az 50 deg)
pairs.short: Same controlled ground under two sub-solar longitudes 50 deg apart.
pairs.sensor_source: LRO NAC controlled mosaic, sub-solar lon bin 005
pairs.sensor_reference: LRO NAC controlled mosaic, sub-solar lon bin 055, warped
pairs.real_component: all pixels are delivered LROC NAC mosaic data; the illumination change between source and reference is real
pairs.synthetic_component: known similarity + perspective warp applied to the reference; truth also carries the ~0.8 px control residual
